First practical fast-market prototype. F6 starts one-outstanding-query native scan from page 0. Each response is processed by the exact native 0x025C handler first, then AuxVmangos aggregates that exact page into the existing MARKET PriceDB; only afterward is the next page sent with 25ms settle. No page-ID correlation is required because at most one request is outstanding. A 1500ms page timeout aborts fail-closed rather than shifting page association. Full scan stops on first short page (<50 rows) or max page 2000. No buying path is changed; FAST MARKET forces scanner/LIVE off while it owns the scheduler. Gameplay validation pending.
